zh-CN.title: 好友上线提醒更及时
items: 好友上线消息仅通过即时提醒发送，不再进入网页、邮件或短信渠道
通知设置会明确禁用好友上线不适用的提醒渠道

en.title: Timelier friend-online alerts
items: Friend-online events now use instant notifications only, never web, email, or SMS delivery
Notification settings now clearly disable unsupported routes for friend-online alerts
